summary: Short answer: there is no vertical spacing in either crate apart from whole blank rows. Every chat line is one ratatui row, and the desktop paints every row at the same height. All the spacing you see comes from blank lines already in the source text, plus one gap the renderer adds before headings. Rows with inline code are the same height as other rows; they only look taller (explained in 2.3).
